messages.subject: Pinnacle House letting - engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Edward,

Thank you for instructing us on the proposed letting of Floors 4 and 5 of Pinnacle House to Brookmere Software. I attach our engagement letter and terms of business - please sign and return the acceptance at your convenience.

Elena Marchetti will run the matter day to day. Our next steps are to agree heads of terms with the tenant's side (Pemberton Rowe) and to put the agreement for lease and lease into draft. Our fee estimate is £14,500-£18,000 plus VAT and disbursements.

Kind regards
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner, Real Estate | Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
